executiveSummary: Two blocking runtime defects in the worker were identified and corrected: architecture key mismatch ('ace-step-15' vs 'ace-step-1.5') and missing VAE/text-encoder loading in the ace-step-1.5 loader. Txt2AudioHandler was updated to use vae.decode(), torchaudio at 44.1 kHz, 5-second trailing-silence trim, and generate_audio_codes=False for negative conditioning. Post-save file existence check added per FR-6.
minorObservations: text_encoder and text_encoder2 filenames in models.config.json are placeholders — must be replaced with real ACE-Step 1.5 checkpoint filenames before deployment.
generate_audio_codes=False was missing from negative conditioning call; corrected in txt2audio.py.
No UI accessibility or UX gaps found in playground.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: All audit findings were applied. The pipeline is now structurally and functionally aligned with the PRD. Remaining action: replace placeholder text encoder filenames in models.config.json with actual ACE-Step 1.5 checkpoint filenames.

refactorPlan.changes: Fixed _LOADERS key to 'ace-step-1.5'; added load_vae; load both text encoders with clip_type='ace'.
Added text_encoder and text_encoder2 component fields to acestep-v15-base entry.
Replaced scipy with torchaudio at 44100 Hz; added vae.decode(); added 5-sec trim with 1-sec floor; added generate_audio_codes=False for negative; added post-save existence check.
